preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The length of the string s in each test case is between 1 and 50, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == 'YES' if s[i] in YesYesYes... else 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' if the string s is a substring of the infinite repetition of 'Yes', otherwise output 'NO'.
